conclusion: On API35 emulator, both upstream entry points reproducibly die with the actual production grant-denial SecurityException; the PR2201 diagnostic APK handles the same monitored result twice per entry point, emits the failure Toast, preserves the five captured storage-state fields and offers retry while Activity remains alive before instrumentation finishes. scope_limits: Synthetic Instrumentation.ActivityMonitor RESULT_OK with ungranted tree URI; actual provider activity is blocked. Real production ActivityResultRegistry and StorageAccess parseResult/takePersistable execute. Not an actual DocumentsUI/provider-returned failure and not direct onActivityResult simulation.

Clicks use accessibility ACTION_CLICK on actual attached activities; no InputDispatcher touch injection, no physical device, API35 emulator only. Setup uses actual step-one action and setup_entry=ui, with explicitly seeded EXT+empty URI. Settings uses existing old valid tree grant and original Change dialog.

A directly caught resolver SecurityException preflight proves the chosen URI is ungrantable; it is separate from the production attempt. Baseline production log stack independently establishes the actual production exception. Fixed exception type is inferred from equivalent path/preflight because production catches it internally.

Compared mode, selected URI, manifest path/existence/bytes/SHA256, dedicated private sentinel path/existence/bytes/SHA256 and persisted URI grant records after each failure. This is not a complete hash of all private/external data nor proof that no unrelated file changed.

Fixture preparation intentionally changes mode/URI before snapshots and may create a dedicated sentinel. Snapshot equality applies to attempted picker failure after fixture preparation. Root cleanup is separately recorded.

Activity pre-finish checks and second retry prove bounded continued use before finish. Android finishInstrumentation stops the target even on passing tests; absent post-finish PID is not product failure.

This denial occurs before persistTreeUri. No runtime claim covers post-persist sync/deploy failure rollback, successful selection, null user cancellation, lifecycle cancellation, APP-to-external fallback or historical upgrade cause.

Source review found CancellationException rethrow and silent null selection cancellation preserved; later persistence/sync failures are not transactional and Setup nonempty-URI completion behavior predates this patch.

Two earlier pre-picker navigation/precondition failures are retained and excluded from product pass/fail. System phone/SystemUI/Quickstep/media-provider ANRs and warning/error counts are retained; no zero-warning or universal ANR resolution claim.
